title: narcissus pallidiflorus subsp. macrolobus
intro: Narcissus pallidiflorus subsp. macrolobus, commonly known as Chinese Narcissus, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the Amaryllidaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties, making it effective in treating various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Narcissus pallidiflorus subsp. macrolobus include sedative, anti-anxiety, and anti-inflammatory effects, which contribute to its use in treating stress, anxiety, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are being studied for their potential in developing new pharmaceuticals.
